entries.e2b6e322fc80fc35: As its management policy, the company sets out the mission "Happiness, for future generations." and the vision "An arrow that transforms Japan," and develops business as an industrial DX company. In the automotive industry DX business, it states that, by building a platform that fuses online, offline, and DX, it will lead the formation of an "economic sphere of automotive distribution DX" and promote a roll-up strategy to horizontally deploy the automobile dealership DX model demonstrated at its consolidated subsidiary Patio Co., Ltd. to used car dealerships and new car dealers nationwide. In the horizontal DX business, it states that it will advance diversification of solutions and thoroughly provide on-site practical support through its professional network.
